THE REAL GAP is measurement: tools/camera/ has gen-cells.mjs only. ZERO probes exist. No m-cam0*.mjs method scripts. RI-MTH04 voids any claim without a real run, so probes are the highest-value remaining work.
HARNESS GOTCHA (cost 40 min): queueInputs() event frames are RELATIVE to the call frame (pipeline.scriptBase), NOT absolute. Use {f:0} for 'next step'.
HARNESS GOTCHA: tap/hold/until are SCENARIO-FILE sugar expanded by tools/lib/scenario.mjs. In-page queueInputs has a CLOSED key set {f,press,release,move,look} and throws on anything else.

HARNESS GOTCHA: teleport(x,z) uses the PROVINCE heightfield. The camera cells are separate fixtures; teleport(0,0) drops the player to y=-41.3 which is under cam-flat-plain's floor plane. Must pass {y: cell.ground_y}.
look:[dx,dy] is DEGREES per frame already; look_stick:[x,y] is the raw stick that gets the deadzone/quadratic curve. Two keys because CAM02 M1 measures the curve and M3 measures the degree path.
Mouse wheel IS handled (input/real.js:91) but maps to swap_right/swap_left (bindings.js:25-26), not zoom. RI-CAM05 §F satisfied; probe dispatches real WheelEvents to prove it.

DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (engine): Engine._settleWorld() ran in _afterStep(), AFTER the camera placed the pivot and AFTER the trace record was built. So camera.pivot.y - player.pos.y in the trace was 42.86 m, not 1.55 m, and the pivot followed a one-frame-stale Y on every slope. RI-CAM01 SA requires the pivot to read the post-locomotion position. Moved into stepOnce, physics slot, before the camera. Verified: delta 1.55 exactly.

DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (camera): the shoulder offset was scaled by len/4.10, so the RI-CAM01 M1 census read 0.42 only at pitch 0 unlocked (0.344 at -55, 0.369 locked). Now scaled against the length the CAST was run at: exactly 0.42/0.10 unobstructed at every pitch and mode, and still on the cleared ray when collision shortens the boom.

MEASURED OFF THE REFERENCE CLIP (Godrick, 60fps, 5 frames, 8x8 NDC grid): player anchor sits at NDC y -0.40..-0.75 for a whole big-boss fight -- OUTSIDE the +-0.70 safe rect, ON screen, and upstream does NOT zoom out to fix it. CAM03 SC step 5 read literally is a ratchet to the 7.50 m cap = the strategy-game camera the item's own How-we-lose #5 names. Split into hard (anchor off screen, full range) and soft (TARGET outside safe rect, capped 1.20 m) drivers; player-low-but-on-screen gets no correction. Justified by SC's priority order and by SE having NO safe-rect bar on P_a. Recorded in game/data/camera/reference-framing.json.

PERF: groundYInCell naive 0.02 m descent from y=12 was 800 contains() x 158 shapes = 126k shape tests/frame and made an 8-yaw route walk take >8 min. Coarse 0.10 m + 10 bisections + locality hint. Measured after: ~1.8 ms per (stepFrames(1)+getCameraFrame) pair, 1298 frames per mangrove lap.

DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (harness perf): stepFrames() renders a full frame at the END OF EVERY CALL (engine.js: if(loop.renderRateHz!==0) loop.renderNow()). Under headless software WebGL that is ~500 ms. Measured: 200 x stepFrames(1) = 105,677 ms; 100 BATCHED steps = 8-19 ms. Every per-frame probe in the corpus pays this. Probes now call setRenderRate(0). This is a HARNESS property worth telling every other builder.

DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (engine): spawn() grounded entities against the PROVINCE heightfield even with a camera fixture active, so a target spawned in cam-boss-arena sat 41 m below the player. First full probe run: onscreen_fraction(T_a)=0.000 in all 7 lock scenarios while P_a=1.000, and the pitch law flat at -50 deg for every d. Added Engine.groundInActiveCell().

DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (camera): the penetration guard drove the arm to arm_hard_min_m 0.30 m. Measured min arm_len 0.3499 on two of three worst routes. RI-CAM05 SF makes arm<0.90 an AUTOMATIC FAIL of the piece. SC step 7's 'unbounded' overrides step 6's RATE LIMIT, not step 5's clamp. Guard floored at 0.90.

DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (camera): menu/dialogue froze the ANGLES but not the pivot, so with the world still simulating (S14) the camera drifted 13.5 m over 300 menu frames. Pivot now detaches in frozen modes, same mechanism as death.
DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (camera): uiOpen('dialogue') re-armed the accommodation on re-entry, i.e. on every topic change -- exactly what RI-CAM05 SB forbids. Measured a second 1.92 deg swing.
DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (engine): camera({mode:'first'}) threw AFTER assigning c.override, so a refused call left the rig suspended. Validate before mutating.

OPEN at handoff: clip_through > 0 in cistern/boardwalk/stair. First run 2440 frames over 6 cells x 8 yaws; independent origin-in-solid was far smaller (42/2/35), so most are NEAR-PLANE CORNERS not the origin. With the 0.90 floor now enforced this will likely RISE, and the corpus's own answer (RI-CAM05 SD) is architectural -- widen the fixture, do not shorten the arm.

DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (camera, automatic fail): basis() folded the shake into the forward vector and desiredPoint() builds the camera POSITION from it, so the 'rotational only' shake was POSITIONAL -- 0.277 m over 20 events. RI-CAM06 SG lists positional shake as an automatic fail. Split rig basis (no shake, places the camera) from view basis (with shake, projection + clip). Measured after: 0 m exactly.

DEFECT FOUND+FIXED (camera, the headline): a first-order spring CANNOT satisfy RI-CAM03 SE. Lag = rate/alpha. CMB06 yaw half-life 0.120 s -> alpha 0.0904/frame; M3's target orbits at 300 deg/s = 5.00 deg/frame; steady-state lag 55.3 deg vs a horizontal half-angle of 42.8 deg. The target leaves the SCREEN. Measured T_a 0.61/0.35/0.83/0.57 vs a 0.995 bar. Fix: the spring runs at its declared half-life while framing holds and ramps to the [CMB06] 7 deg/frame CLAMP as the anchor crosses the safe rect toward the frame edge (SC priority (1) is never sacrificed; the clamp is a ceiling not a budget). duel-infantry T_a 0.61 -> 1.000; acquire 80f -> 17f; reframe 29f -> 6f.

CLIP-THROUGH ROOT CAUSE, ATTRIBUTED (RI-CAM01 M2b): every clip frame in the build occurs at arm_len == 0.900 m EXACTLY -- the camera is at the corpus-mandated floor and the geometry is still nearer than the boom. Longest runs: cistern 211 f at pivot [3.4, 5.4, -25.8] (up the spiral stair), stair 64 f at [0, 1.6, -3.2], boardwalk 36 f at [4.2, 2.7, -6]. cam-walk-mangrove, cam-boss-arena and cam-rig-pinch are ZERO over 8 yaws each. So this is not a rig bug: it is the arithmetic of a 0.90 m boom plus a 0.28 m cast sphere plus a 0.10 m near plane needing ~1.2 m of clear space behind the character, in fixtures that pinch below it. RI-CAM05 SD's answer is architectural and the remedy is an edit to tools/camera/gen-cells.mjs, not to the arm.

POSSIBLE EARNED AMENDMENT (not filed -- ran out of budget to make it properly): RI-CAM05 SD's crawl space is 1.40 m wide x 1.60 m ceiling and SD's table still demands Sigma clip_through == 0 there. With RI-CAM01 SA's 1.55 m pivot the pivot sits 0.05 m BELOW that ceiling, and a 0.90 m arm at the resting -8 deg pitch puts the camera at 1.55 + 0.10 + 0.90*sin(8) = 1.78 m, i.e. 0.18 m ABOVE the ceiling. Zero clip in a 1.60 m crawl space is geometrically impossible given SA's own numbers. A successor should either verify this arithmetic and file it, or show where I have it wrong.

ar3_seam_crossing: The SAME RIG frames a Souls boss fight and a Morrowind topic list. camera.mode transitions free -> dialogue with bit-identical pivot height (1.55 m), FOV (50.0), arm law and collision; the only permitted motion is one bounded accommodation (measured 1.92 deg yaw, +0.5842 m arm, 12 frames, pitch exactly 0) and then the pose is frozen. There is no conversation camera, no cut, no shot-reverse-shot -- an AR-2 leak the corpus names as the most likely one in the whole camera area. The consequence is the crossing: an NPC stays a body standing in a place you can be attacked in rather than a portrait, which is what makes seam S13's 'topic lists locked during COMBAT' a CONSEQUENCE rather than a mode switch. Second, structural: RI-CAM05 SD's 2.60 m / 3.20 m interior minimum exists because the Souls spring arm needs it, and it binds the Morrowind-side hand-placed interiors -- declared in game/data/camera/cells.json and printed by `node tools/camera/gen-cells.mjs --audit`.
